caption: The drawing displays a painted wooden statue of a standing human figure positioned on a rectangular pedestal base. The figure is depicted with dark tan skin and long dark hair, some of which falls over the shoulders. The figure wears a headband with three large feathers colored in shades of green, yellow, and brown. The upper part of the body is dressed in a reddish garment draped over the left shoulder and arm, while the right arm and shoulder are covered by a greenish-yellow tunic. The tunic’s hem and neckline have decorative borders. The figure’s legs are bare, but there are green anklets on the feet, and brown sandals. In the right hand, the figure holds a bundle of green leaves or plants, while the left hand holds a cylindrical object that appears to be a wooden block or container. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, with a neutral beige color filling the entire space around the statue.
